	TFExtrusionHoraFinProceso_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_ExtrusionHoraFinProcesoAuxDateText.InternalName)
	TFExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_ExtrusionHoraIniciaProcesoAuxDateText.InternalName)
	TFExtrusionFecha_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_ExtrusionFechaAuxDateText.InternalName)
	
	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	If &HTTPRequest.Method = HttpMethod.Get
		Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndIf
	ddo_AGExport.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnAGExport.InternalName
	&AGExportData = new()
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'Export'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExportReport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'ExportReport'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&IsAuthorized_ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'extrusionview_Execute')
	
	&GAMSession = GAMSession.Get(&GAMErrors)
	DDO_Grid.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_Grid.GAMOAuthToken = &GAMSession.Token
	Form.Caption = ' Extrusion'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	If &OrderedBy < 1
		&OrderedBy = 1
		Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnEditColumns.InternalName
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	Do Case
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 1
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 0
			Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndCase
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	
	If &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarExtrusionColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarExtrusionColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf
	ExtrusionId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(1).IsVisible
	ExtrusionExtrusoraId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(2).IsVisible
	ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(3).IsVisible
	ExtrusionTurnoId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(4).IsVisible
	ExtrusionTurnoNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(5).IsVisible
	ExtrusionProductoId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(6).IsVisible
	ExtrusionProductoNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(7).IsVisible
	ExtrusionProductoTipoMaterial.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(8).IsVisible
	ExtrusionFecha.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(9).IsVisible
	ExtrusionCalibre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(10).IsVisible
	ExtrusionAncho.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(11).IsVisible
	ExtrusionLongitud.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(12).IsVisible
	ExtrusionVirgenKg.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(13).IsVisible
	ExtrusionMeta.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(14).IsVisible
	ExtrusionMolidoKg.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(15).IsVisible
	ExtrusionRevHusilloVirgen.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(16).IsVisible
	ExtrusionRevHusilloMolido.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(17).IsVisible
	ExtrusionEstado.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(18).IsVisible
	ExtrusionOperadorId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(19).IsVisible
	ExtrusionOperadorNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(20).IsVisible
	ExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(21).IsVisible
	ExtrusionHoraFinProceso.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(22).IsVisible
	ExtrusionLoteSilo.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(23).IsVisible
	ExtrusionMotivoAnticipado.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(24).IsVisible
	ExtrusionResultadoBobinasReposoTotales.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(25).IsVisible
	ExtrusionSiloId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(26).IsVisible
	ExtrusionSiloNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(27).IsVisible
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionId'
					&TFExtrusionId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusionId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionExtrusoraId'
					&TFExtrusionExtrusoraId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusionExtrusoraId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre'
					&TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionTurnoId'
					&TFExtrusionTurnoId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusionTurnoId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionTurnoNombre'
					&TFExtrusionTurnoNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFExtrusionTurnoNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionProductoId'
					&TFExtrusionProductoId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusionProductoId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionProductoNombre'
					&TFExtrusionProductoNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFExtrusionProductoNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionProductoTipoMaterial'
					&TFExtrusionProductoTipoMaterial_SelsJson = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
					&TFExtrusionProductoTipoMaterial_Sels.FromJson(&TFExtrusionProductoTipoMaterial_SelsJson)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionFecha'
					&TFExtrusionFecha.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusionFecha_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
					If Not &TFExtrusionFecha_To.IsEmpty()
						&TFExtrusionFecha_To.Set(&TFExtrusionFecha_To.Year(), &TFExtrusionFecha_To.Month(), &TFExtrusionFecha_To.Day(), 23, 59, 59)
					EndIf
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionCalibre'
					&TFExtrusionCalibre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFExtrusionCalibre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionAncho'
					&TFExtrusionAncho = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFExtrusionAncho_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionLongitud'
					&TFExtrusionLongitud = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFExtrusionLongitud_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionVirgenKg'
					&TFExtrusionVirgenKg.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusionVirgenKg_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionMeta'
					&TFExtrusionMeta.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusionMeta_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionMolidoKg'
					&TFExtrusionMolidoKg.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusionMolidoKg_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionRevHusilloVirgen'
					&TFExtrusionRevHusilloVirgen.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusionRevHusilloVirgen_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionRevHusilloMolido'
					&TFExtrusionRevHusilloMolido.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusionRevHusilloMolido_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionEstado'
					&TFExtrusionEstado_SelsJson = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
					&TFExtrusionEstado_Sels.FromJson(&TFExtrusionEstado_SelsJson)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionOperadorId'
					&TFExtrusionOperadorId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusionOperadorId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionOperadorNombre'
					&TFExtrusionOperadorNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFExtrusionOperadorNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso'
					&TFExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
					If Not &TFExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso_To.IsEmpty()
						&TFExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso_To.Set(&TFExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso_To.Year(), &TFExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso_To.Month(), &TFExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso_To.Day(), 23, 59, 59)
					EndIf
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionHoraFinProceso'
					&TFExtrusionHoraFinProceso.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusionHoraFinProceso_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
					If Not &TFExtrusionHoraFinProceso_To.IsEmpty()
						&TFExtrusionHoraFinProceso_To.Set(&TFExtrusionHoraFinProceso_To.Year(), &TFExtrusionHoraFinProceso_To.Month(), &TFExtrusionHoraFinProceso_To.Day(), 23, 59, 59)
					EndIf
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionLoteSilo'
					&TFExtrusionLoteSilo = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFExtrusionLoteSilo_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionMotivoAnticipado'
					&TFExtrusionMotivoAnticipado_SelsJson = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
					&TFExtrusionMotivoAnticipado_Sels.FromJson(&TFExtrusionMotivoAnticipado_SelsJson)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionResultadoBobinasReposoTotales'
					&TFExtrusionResultadoBobinasReposoTotales.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusionResultadoBobinasReposoTotales_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionSiloId'
					&TFExtrusionSiloId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusionSiloId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionSiloNombre'
					&TFExtrusionSiloNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFExtrusionSiloNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */ &Update = !'' If (&IsAuthorized_Update) &Update.Link = DB.Extrusion.Link(TrnMode.Update, ExtrusionId) Endif &Delete = !'' If (&IsAuthorized_Delete) &Delete.Link = DB.Extrusion.Link(TrnMode.Delete, ExtrusionId) Endif If (&IsAuthorized_ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre) ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre.Link = DB.ExtrusionView.Link(ExtrusionId, '') Endif /* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'Produccion.listarExtrusionFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'Produccion.listarExtrusionFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'Produccion.listarExtrusionFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_Insert)
		DB.Extrusion.Call(TrnMode.Insert, nullvalue(ExtrusionId))
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'Export'
			Do 'DoExport'
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'ExportReport'
			Do 'DoExportReport'
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
